An '''air cushion''' was a type of medical device used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in Imperial [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenters]], where they were earmarked for the treatment of burns victims who had suffered extensive skin loss. Patients using air cushions were suspended several [[Foot/Legends|feet]] in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] and via operation of a knob, the patient could be lowered back to the ground.<ref name="The New Rebellion" />

Air cushions were among various pieces of ex-Imperial equipment kept in the home on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Msst]] of the [[Brakiss's mother|mother]] of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Brakiss]].<ref name="The New Rebellion" /> In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Brakiss's mother used several air cushions to treat the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] after he was injured by the [[mistmaker]]s, a [[Species/Legends|species]] of bubble-like predator endemic to Msst.<ref name="The New Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The air cushion and appeared in the [[1996]] [[Bantam Spectra]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel ''[[The New Rebellion]]'', by [[Kristine Kathryn Rusch]].<ref name="The New Rebellion" />
